python3 << 'EOF'
from funcy import rcurry, rpartial, get_spec

# Test rcurry with keyword arguments
@rcurry
def add(a, b, c=10):
    return a + b + c

print("=== rcurry tests ===")
print(f"add(1)(2) = {add(1)(2)}")  # Should be 13 (with default c=10)
print(f"add(1)(2)(3) = {add(1)(2)(3)}")  # Should be 6
print(f"add(1, 2, c=5) = {add(1, 2, c=5)}")  # Should be 8

# Check signature
spec = get_spec(add)
print(f"get_spec(add) = {spec}")

# Test rpartial with keyword arguments
def sub(a, b, *, c=1):
    return a - b - c

print("\n=== rpartial tests ===")
p = rpartial(sub, 10)
print(f"sub(10, 3, c=1) = {p(3, c=1)}")  # Should be 6
print(f"sub(10, 3) = {p(3)}")  # Should be 7 (c defaults to 1)

spec = get_spec(p)
print(f"get_spec(rpartial(sub, 10)) = {spec}")
EOF
